description: Hand-written SMS messages for the live demonstration. The expected labels are human judgements written BEFORE running the model; they were not adjusted to make the model look good. Phone numbers and links marked 'known' appear in the UCI SMS Spam Collection or PhiUSIIL data that forms the graph.

cases.text: Hey, are we still meeting for lunch at 1pm today?
cases.note: Ordinary personal message, no links to the graph.

cases.text: Ok, I'll call you when I get home. Don't wait up.
cases.note: Ordinary personal message, no links to the graph.

cases.text: URGENT! You have won a 1 week FREE membership in our 100,000 Prize Jackpot! Call 08000839402 now to claim.
cases.note: Scam text AND a phone number that already appears in spam messages in the graph.

cases.text: WINNER!! Claim your free prize now at http://www.urawinner.com
cases.note: Scam text AND a link that already appears in spam messages in the graph.

cases.text: URGENT: Your bank account has been suspended. Click this link immediately to verify your account.
cases.note: Scam wording but NO phone number or link, so the message has no connections in the graph.

cases.text: Congratulations! You have been selected for a cash reward. Click this link to claim your prize.
cases.note: Scam wording but NO phone number or link, so the message has no connections in the graph.

cases.text: FREE entry! Text WIN to 80082 or call 09099999999 to claim your 500 pound voucher today.
cases.note: Scam wording with a phone number the graph has never seen.

cases.text: Hi mum, this is my new number 08000839402, call me when you can.
cases.note: Stress test: harmless wording, but the number is one used by spam messages in the graph.

cases.text: Your account document is ready, view it here: https://ipfs.io/ipfs/bafybeiexample/login.html
cases.note: Cross-channel test: an SMS whose link is on a domain used by phishing URLs in the URL dataset.

cases.text: Your parcel is out for delivery today. Thanks for shopping with us.
cases.note: Ordinary notification, no links to the graph.
